journey.name: boost own onchain send by replacement
journey.description: Verifies that Boost replaces an unconfirmed Savings send this wallet made: the boosted send keeps its amount, pays a higher fee and gets a new transaction ID, and confirms after a block. Preconditions: a synced wallet with at least 100,000 confirmed sats in Savings, a regtest address the wallet does not own (for example a fresh Savings address from a second wallet), and access to the configured regtest backend's block-mining helper.

actions.action: Hand the app the address as a URI with xcrun simctl openurl <UDID> "bitcoin:ADDRESS?amount=0.0001", which opens the amount screen at 10,000 sats
Verify the amount screen shows 10,000 sats, tap Continue (id "ContinueAmount") and verify the review screen (id "SendConfirm") is visible
Swipe the send handle (id "GRAB") fully to the right and wait for the success screen (id "SendSuccess"), then tap Close
Tap the newest outgoing activity entry (id "ActivityShort-0") and verify it shows 10,000 sats; record the fee from id "ActivityFee"
Tap Transaction details (id "ActivityTxDetails"), record the TXID, then go back
Tap Boost (id "BoostButton") and verify the replacement boost sheet (id "RBFBoost") is visible
Swipe the boost handle (id "GRAB") fully to the right and verify the boost success toast (id "BoostSuccessToast") appears
Verify the activity list shows the boosting icon (id "BoostingIcon") and still exactly one outgoing entry for this send
Open that entry and verify Boosted (id "BoostedButton") and the Boosting status (id "StatusBoosting"), 10,000 sats, and a fee higher than the recorded one
Tap Transaction details (id "ActivityTxDetails") and verify the TXID differs from the recorded one and the replaced transaction is listed (id "RBFBoosted")
Mine one regtest block with ../bitkit-android/lsp POST /regtest/chain/mine '{"count":1}', borrowed from the sibling Android checkout; a successful command exits with status 0 and prints nothing
Return to the activity list, open the send again and verify its status is Confirmed (id "StatusConfirmed")
